producer.name: Microsoft Publisher
producer.appearance: Explicit frame fonts, margins and object colors; untouched native publication defaults.

observed: Independent fixed2x2 table. Border-only cases set the six original shared edges and explicitly hide all cell fills; text grows the first cell, cleared removes all six edges. Fill-only sets three opaque fills without edges.
limits: Modern producer control. Native repair-free acceptance, broader layout/generation and public source-free writing remain unqualified.
